description: Steps to add a Foundry44 component to the user's project, for any stack (plain HTML, React with or without shadcn, other), with its markup, options and pitfalls. Follow them in the user's project. Pro components need the user's Pro key in this server's Authorization header. Getting a Pro component counts as a download and ends the buyer's 14-day refund window: call get_component only for the Pro component the user chose, never to compare.

name.description: The component's name, as search_components gives it (e.g. 'spotlight-card').

settings.description: Optional values that differ from the defaults: an option by its name (e.g. {"duration": 800}); a colour by its CSS variable (e.g. {"--f44-spotlight-card-color": "secondary"}) with a palette role of the project (brand, secondary, text, background, muted) or a #rrggbb hex.

name: get_component
title: Install a Foundry44 component
